name: tr2m

extra_inputs.name: text_features
extra_inputs.meaning: CLIP embedding of the prompt, computed outside the engine

outputs.name: relative_depth
outputs.meaning: the Depth Anything prediction the scale map is applied to

caveats: the only two-input model here: image plus a [1,1,768] CLIP text embedding. CLIP is not in the engine, so the prompt is fixed at export time and its embedding is committed as text_features.npy
434x560, not the 518x518 the rest use, so a frames-per-second comparison is between different amounts of work
upstream's pos_embed.py is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The clone stays out of this repository and nothing from it is vendored
metric depth is produced from a relative model by predicting a per-pixel scale and shift, so its errors are those of Depth Anything plus those of the rescaling

encoder.source: upstream README: the released checkpoint is built on Depth Anything ViT-S; no other size is published
